meta.title: QiBi writing desk
meta.description: QiBi writing desk: read and write QiBi manuscripts from the DSH sidebar, with 12 tools, 13 AI writing actions and pre-write revision backups.

ui.themeWhiteDescription: Keep the current white canvas, pale gray sidebar and near-black primary buttons for everyday writing.
ui.themeClaudeDescription: Warm grays and a caramel accent, inspired by the restrained layers of Claude Style.
ui.themeParchmentDescription: Paper tones with brown-gold accents for a softer reading surface.
ui.themeForestDescription: Quiet green surfaces and deep green accents with clear prose.
ui.themeDuskDescription: Gray-violet surfaces and a soft purple accent for a different writing atmosphere.
ui.themeRoseDescription: Pale rose-gray surfaces with berry accents, balancing softness and clarity.
ui.themeHostDescription: Use the host's current colors and appearance without overriding the QiBi palette.
ui.themeHostHint: This preset follows DSH. The appearance options below do not override it.
ui.themeScopeHint: Applies only to QiBi and its dialogs. It does not change the global DSH theme, reload chapters or modify manuscripts.
ui.themeInstantHint: Changes apply immediately and are remembered in this browser.
ui.themeSaved: Appearance preferences remembered in this browser.
ui.themeSaveFailed: Appearance applied, but this browser blocked saving preferences. Reloading may restore defaults.
ui.themeSampleProse: A character's choice changes the course of the next chapter.
ui.noDbHint: Choose a data location below and save. Create an empty database or connect an existing one; old manuscripts are never imported automatically. Tried: {path}
ui.dataSettingsModeHintCreate: Initialize a folder without a database. No sample novels are added, and existing files are never overwritten.
ui.dataSettingsModeHintExisting: Choose the folder containing novelforge.db to read its manuscripts. Files remain where they are.
ui.dataSettingsNoMove: Saving changes the active location without moving, copying or overwriting old manuscripts.
ui.dataSettingsCannotSave: This host has no configuration editor, so it cannot save the data location.
ui.dataSettingsLoadFailed: Could not read data location settings. Retry to continue.
ui.dataSettingsInfoPageConfirm: Changing data location reloads the workbench. Save changes on the current reference page first. Continue?
ui.emptyNovelHint: Create a novel here, or connect an existing database from Data location.
ui.emptyChapterHint: Create the first chapter here, or ask the agent to write it.
ui.emptyBody: This chapter has no prose yet.
ui.conflictHint: Your edit was not written, so the manuscript is not overwritten. Reload QiBi's version, or force your content over it (a backup is taken first).
ui.emptyOutline: This novel has no outline yet.
ui.emptyCharacters: This novel has no character sheets yet.
ui.noChapterHint: Create or select a chapter on the left first.
ui.externalChange: This chapter changed on disk; save or reload to sync.
ui.emptyVolumes: This novel has no volumes yet.
ui.foreshadowingInvalid: Foreshadowing ledger must be valid JSON
ui.revisionsEmpty: This chapter has no revisions yet.
ui.confirmDeleteNovel: Delete this novel and all of its chapters and settings?
ui.confirmDeleteChapter: Delete this chapter permanently? Its revision history is deleted with it.
ui.confirmRestore: Replace the current prose with this revision? The current prose is backed up first.
ui.confirmReindex: Rebuild the knowledge base index for this whole novel?
ui.distillStartHint: Create one with ＋ on the left, then upload samples or paste text.
ui.distillNoSources: No sources yet. Upload a file or paste text.
ui.distillFilesHint: TXT / MD / HTML / JSON / EPUB, up to 100MB each.
ui.distillAgentHint: Generation runs in the DSH agent. Copy the instruction below into the chat; the agent reads the sources, generates the three parts and saves a version.
ui.distillInstructionCopied: Instructions copied. Paste into the DSH chat and send, then return here and refresh when generation finishes.
ui.distillNoVersions: No versions yet. Copy the instruction and hand it to the agent first.
ui.distillNotBound: No distilled author is bound to this novel
ui.confirmDeleteDistillAuthor: Delete this distilled author and all of its sources and versions?
ui.aiReasoningHint: Applies to generation and continuation in this panel. Remembered per model, without changing global DSH settings.
ui.aiReasoningUnsupported: This model declares no adjustable thinking levels. Current defaults will be used.
ui.aiReasoningUnknown: Thinking levels are temporarily unavailable. Current defaults will be used; reopen the panel to retry.
ui.aiHistoryLegacyContinuation: This older continuation did not record its source scope. It is preview/copy only. Generate again from the current prose to create a new result; it cannot overwrite the chapter directly.
ui.aiHistorySelectionMissing: The original selection was not saved or its text changed. You can still preview and copy this result. Select the original text and generate again to replace it safely; a selection result will not overwrite the chapter.
ui.characterAiGenerateTitle: Create a character from an idea
ui.characterAiChapterHint: Analyze the saved current chapter. Empty chapters cannot be analyzed.
ui.characterAiAllHint: Analyze saved prose from first to last chapter in batches. Each click makes one model call. Long chapters resume at the previous position instead of reading only their opening.
ui.characterAiIdea: Describe the character in one sentence
ui.characterAiIdeaPlaceholder: For example: a young healer who avoids close relationships but risks their life for strangers.
ui.characterAiPreviewHint: Generation creates a preview only. Characters are saved after you confirm import.
ui.characterAiReadOnly: Read-only mode allows preview generation and editing, but not import.
ui.characterAiCancelled: Request cancelled. You can start again.
ui.characterAiPreviewReady: Candidates are ready. Select and edit them before confirming import.
ui.characterAiEmpty: No candidates found. Adjust the scope or description and retry.
ui.characterAiTruncated: Only part of the requested scope was analyzed; these candidates may not cover the entire novel.
ui.characterAiReviewHint: Review the details. Existing names are skipped and never overwritten.
ui.characterAiDuplicate: This name already exists and will be skipped during import.
ui.aiExtraHint: Optional: specific requirements, taboos or direction
ui.aiPreviewHint: Pick an action and press Generate. The result appears here before you apply it.
ui.aiNeedSelection: Select some text in the prose first
ui.aiUnavailable: No model is available in DSH. Pick one in the model selector first.
ui.aiSelectionStale: The selected text changed; select it again.
ui.formatTitle: Normalize paragraph indents to two full-width spaces
ui.zenHint: Focus mode (Alt+F): hide the sidebar and tabs, enlarge the text
ui.readonlyWriteOff: Writing is off — use the switch in the top bar to edit
ui.readonlyConflict: Version conflict — reload or overwrite first
ui.aiAppliedHint: AI result applied to the chapter
ui.emptyOutlineHint: Use the master outline for the whole book and chapter outlines for per-chapter beats; AI follows them when drafting.
ui.emptyCharactersHint: Record your main characters here — writing and AI generation will use them automatically.
ui.revisionsEmptyHint: A version is saved automatically before each save or AI rewrite.
ui.anchorPlaceholder: Text to locate in the chapter
ui.anchorNoMarker: This outline has no anchor text
ui.anchorMissing: Could not find "{marker}" in the chapter — set a more precise anchor.
ui.anchorDoneHint: Found in the chapter — click to jump
ui.anchorTodoHint: Not written yet — click to try locating
ui.entityConflict: This item changed in another window or by the agent. Your input is preserved. Copy what you need before reloading or reopening the form.
ui.discardInfoDraftConfirm: Reloading will discard unsaved changes in this form. Continue?
ui.characterStateReadFailed: The character ledger could not be loaded. Saving is blocked to protect the existing inventory and relationships. Retry loading first.
ui.chapterRemovedDraftKept: Another window deleted this chapter. Your unsaved local prose is still here; copy it to a safe place first.
ui.aiSourceChanged: The current novel, chapter or write mode changed. This AI result was not applied. Return to the original chapter and retry.
ui.aiHistoryLegacyScope: This older result did not record its library or author. It can be previewed and copied, but cannot be written directly to this chapter.
ui.discardDraftConfirm: Your unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
ui.aiIncomplete: The output did not finish (interrupted or hit the length limit); it can be copied but not applied.
ui.aiNoOutline: No chapter outline yet. This run will rely on the master outline, chapter summaries, characters, foreshadowing and the previous chapter — adding a chapter outline usually keeps the draft on track.
ui.aiHistoryLoad: Load this result (copy or apply again)
ui.aiTruncated: The output hit the model length limit and is incomplete. Use "Continue" to keep writing, or copy it out first.
ui.densityComfortableHint: Larger controls and helper text for easier everyday use. Manuscripts and colors stay the same.
ui.densityCompactHint: Keep the original compact layout to fit more information on screen.
ui.distillGuideTitle: Distill a writing style in four steps
ui.distillGuideIntro: Create an author and add samples, ask the agent in chat to generate a style version, then apply it to your novel.
ui.distillGuideSetupHint: Create an author profile to organize samples you have permission to use and generated style versions.
ui.distillGuideMaterialsHint: Upload sample chapters or paste text. Once parsing succeeds, you can generate a style.
ui.distillGuideGenerateHint: Copy the generation instructions, paste them into this DSH chat and send. Return here and refresh after the agent saves a version.
ui.distillGuideBindHint: A style version is ready. Apply it to the current novel so future generation can refer to it.
ui.distillGuideDoneHint: This author style is applied to this novel. You can add more samples, inspect versions or roll back.
ui.distillGuideReadOnly: Read-only mode allows viewing and copying instructions. Adding samples or applying styles requires write access.
ui.distillPasteIntoChat: Next: paste into the DSH chat and send
ui.distillAfterChatHint: This page does not send a message automatically. After chat saves a version, refresh below and apply it to the novel.
ui.distillCopyManual: Copy the instructions below manually, then paste them into the DSH chat.
ui.foreshadowEmptyReadOnly: No threads yet. Read-only mode lets you inspect the advanced JSON.
ui.continuityReadFailed: The data could not be loaded. Saving is blocked to protect existing data. Retry loading first.
ui.foreshadowEmpty: No threads yet. Add one to start tracking.
ui.foreshadowDeleteConfirm: Delete this thread? The change takes effect after saving writing state.
ui.foreshadowAdvancedHint: Edit raw JSON directly. It shares the same draft as the list. Save writing state to persist your changes.
ui.foreshadowUnsupported: This ledger structure cannot be edited as a list safely. Its original JSON is preserved for editing here.
ui.foreshadowJsonInvalid: Invalid JSON. Your draft is preserved; fix it to return to list editing.
ui.characterAiChaptersEmpty: This novel has no chapters to analyze.
ui.characterAiRangeInvalid: The last chapter cannot precede the first.
ui.characterAiBatchHint: Each analysis click makes one model call using saved prose. Keep prose and chapter order unchanged between batches; restart if they change.
ui.characterAiResetConfirm: This clears unimported candidates and analysis progress.
ui.characterAiSelectionLimit: Import up to 30 characters at a time. Unselected candidates are kept.
ui.characterAiBatchInvalid: The batch response was invalid. Retry this batch.
ui.novelCreateHint: Add a title first. You can fill in the other details later.
ui.novelSettingsHint: Edit the novel details and save to apply them. Manage prose and chapters in the writing desk.
ui.novelReadOnlyHint: Read-only mode lets you view and copy details. Enable writing to save changes.
ui.novelAuthorHint: The pen name displayed on this novel can differ from the account name.
ui.novelCustomValueHint: Choose a suggestion or enter your own value.
ui.novelIntroHint: Summarize the setting, central characters and main conflict, or leave this blank.
ui.novelIntroPlaceholder: Where does the story happen? What does the protagonist want, and what stands in the way?
ui.novelDeleteHint: Deleting the novel also deletes its chapters, outlines, characters and continuity data. This cannot be undone here. Export anything you need to keep first.
ui.novelDeleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” and all of its chapters and settings? This cannot be undone.
ui.novelDiscardChanges: Discard unsaved changes to these novel settings and close?
ui.novelNameRequired: Enter a novel title containing more than whitespace.
ui.novelSavedRefreshFailed: The operation was saved, but the novel list could not refresh. Refresh the workbench later instead of submitting again.
ui.outlineWorkspaceHint: Organize plot notes by master outline and chapter. Select an entry to read or edit it.
ui.outlineReadOnlyHint: Read-only mode lets you view and copy outlines.
ui.outlineFormHint: Enter a title or body text. Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter saves; Esc cancels.
ui.outlineNeedsText: Enter a title or body text containing more than whitespace.
ui.outlineTargetMissing: The attached chapter is unavailable. Choose another chapter or the master outline before saving.
ui.outlineEntryMissing: This entry was deleted. Your local draft is preserved; copy it before creating a new entry.
ui.outlineConflictHint: This outline changed in another window or tool. Your draft is preserved. Copy anything you need before reloading.
ui.outlineReloadConfirm: Reloading discards this local draft and loads the latest entry. Continue?
ui.outlineDiscardConfirm: Discard unsaved changes to this outline and continue?
ui.outlineDiscardChanges: Discard unsaved outline changes and leave?
ui.outlineSelectHint: Choose “Read full entry” from the list, or create a master or chapter outline.
ui.outlineNoMatchesHint: Choose a different target or clear the search.
ui.continuityOrganizerAutoTitle: For this novel, marking a chapter published in QiBi sends saved prose to the current model and saves continuity notes.
ui.continuityOrganizerAutoConfirm: Enable automatic organization for this novel? Marking a chapter published in QiBi calls the current model and saves missing notes and new clues, which may incur model charges. Existing notes and prose are preserved.
ui.continuityOrganizerHasSummary: Existing notes are preserved; only blanks are filled
ui.continuityOrganizerReady: Ready to organize the summary, events, ending and new clues
ui.continuityOrganizerAlreadyOrganized: This saved version was already organized; no repeated model call
ui.continuityOrganizerLedgerSkipped: The existing ledger format cannot be appended safely and was preserved
ui.continuityOrganizerSaveProse: Wait for the prose to finish saving
ui.continuityOrganizerLoadError: Loading failed; retry loading the notes first
ui.continuityOrganizerSaveNotes: Save or reload the manual edits on this page first
ui.continuityOrganizerPreferenceNotSaved: The setting applies to this session only; this browser could not remember it
ui.continuityOrganizerPublishEnabled: This novel organizes notes automatically after publication
ui.continuityVolumesOptional: Optional: group the story into stages
